company.description:
Mofa Technology offers an intelligent and industrialized infrastructure for 3D virtual content production, as well as full-stack technology and product services for creating, educating, and employing people for the virtual world and developing a virtual world infrastructure platform. 

Mofa Technology has built three key platform-based product lines in the virtual world, relying on the high-tech R&D team, full-stack self-developed computer graphics, and Al core technology, combined with professional art capabilities, and completed the pan-entertainment, cultural tourism, consumption, e-commerce, finance, education, medical care, communications, and other fields of multi-dimensional layout and in-depth application, forming a "1+2+3+X" ecological development pattern.
